name: DataCore Design
purpose: Machine-readable UI contracts for DataCore main platform and AION-compatible surfaces.

artifacts.name: DesignSculpture
artifacts.purpose: A Blender-authored modular form used as a non-semantic homepage visual anchor.
artifacts.loadingRule: Render the poster first; load the interactive model only after an explicit user action.
artifacts.motionRule: No automatic rotation; user controls the camera and can reset the view.

components.name: Button
components.sideEffectRule: compute, write, quota, and external actions require explicit confirmation

components.name: StatusLine
components.rule: text and icon must carry meaning; color is supplementary

components.name: Citation
components.rule: stable ID links fact superscript to source record; never infer with string matching
